title: Madketplace X Enchanting Infuser
description: Compatibility between Madketplace and Enchanting Infuser
body:
Adds compatability between Enchanting Infuser & Madketplace, as I belive that the Enchanting Infuser is too easy to obtain. 

With enchanting enfuser, it feels like it should be late-game, as it let's you choose you're enchaantments, but the recipies are not too complicated.
